items.heading: Zero Waste Plan Checks and Compliance Inspections Fees (Continued from May 19, 2026) (Item contains revised materials)
items.action: Action: M/S/C (Tregub/Humbert) to adopt Resolution No. 72,312–N.S. including revised materials in Supplemental Communications Packet #1 and further amended to add the following language to Exhibit A to the resolution. “Notwithstanding any other provision of this fee schedule, fees associated with solar permit applications shall be applied in a manner consistent with Government Code §66015. Where applicable, the Zero Waste plan review and compliance inspection fee shall be adjusted, reduced, or waived as necessary to ensure that total permit- related fees do not exceed the maximum amounts permitted by state law.” Vote: All Ayes.

motions.text: adopt Resolution No. 72,312–N.S. including revised materials in Supplemental Communications Packet #1 and further amended to add the following language to Exhibit A to the resolution. “Notwithstanding any other provision of this fee schedule, fees associated with solar permit applications shall be applied in a manner consistent with Government Code §66015. Where applicable, the Zero Waste plan review and compliance inspection fee shall be adjusted, reduced, or waived as necessary to ensure that total permit- related fees do not exceed the maximum amounts permitted by state law.”

items.heading: Appeal of the Housing Advisory Commission decision to deny the appeal and affirm the Determination by the Building Official for 1615 Fairview Street Regarding the Applicability of Exterior Elevated Elements Inspection Requirement
items.action: Action: M/S/C (Bartlett/Kesarwani) to adopt Resolution No. 72,313–N.S. affirming the Housing Advisory Commission (HAC) decision to (1) deny the Appeal and affirm the Building Official’s determination that 1615 Fairview Street is not in compliance with the Exterior Elevated Elements (E3) Inspection Program; and (2) uphold the associated fees consistent with Council-adopted policy and State law. Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Bartlett, Tregub, O’Keefe, Blackaby, Lunaparra, Humbert; Noes – None; Abstain – None; Absent – Ishii (recused for living in close proximity to the subject property).

vote.as_printed: Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Bartlett, Tregub, O’Keefe, Blackaby, Lunaparra, Humbert; Noes – None; Abstain – None; Absent – Ishii (recused for living in close proximity to the subject property).
